newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, Dec/March widens.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, Dec/March widens.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, with nearby December gaining relative to March amid concerns over tight stocks, traders said.
USDA's quarterly stocks report, released at 0730 CDT Monday, showed the U.S. wheat supply as of September 1 at 1.724 billion bushels, below average analysts' estimates of 1.767 billion bushels.

Spring wheat spent much of the session lower on spillover pressure from a sharp drop in CBOT corn and soybeans. But wheat firmed late thanks to a short-covering rally instigated in Chicago, traders said.
MGE spring wheat closed six cents per bushel lower to 3/4 cents higher, with Dec up 3/4 cents at $4.23-3/4.

Traders said Continental was an early bull-spreader of 500,000 Dec/March at eight cents per bushel. But the spread widened to 10 cents late when Benson-Quinn bear-spread 500,000 March/Dec, traders said. BQ also bought 1.3 million Dec.
"The widening of the spread gained momentum late," a MGE trader said.
MGE barley futures closed 12 to 14 cents per cwt lower, with Dec down 12 cents at $6.98.
